rules.description: Block SQL string concatenation (OWASP Web A03)
rules.message: Possible SQL injection — use parameterised queries.
rules.recommendation: Use parameterised queries. Never concatenate or f-string user input into SQL or shell commands.

rules.description: Warn on MD5/SHA1 for passwords (OWASP Web A02)
rules.message: MD5/SHA1 is weak for password hashing — use bcrypt or argon2.
rules.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger for general hashing, bcrypt/argon2 for passwords, AES-GCM for symmetric encryption.

rules.description: Warn when an agent writes to persistent memory without a source or trust classification tag (OWASP ASI06, MITRE ATLAS AML.M0031)
rules.message: Memory write is missing source or trust classification. Untagged content can silently become policy across future sessions.
rules.recommendation: Tag every memory write with source (trusted|untrusted|external), origin (user|scraped|tool_output|internal), and classification.

enforcement.guarantee: Wire-level checks on memory-write and cross-context memory-read tool calls. Complements in-process memory hardening libraries such as OWASP Agent Memory Guard.
requires: Guard proxy or hook sees memory tool calls before execution
Memory tool follows a recognisable naming pattern (save|memorize|remember|upsert|insert|store|persist) or is an MCP memory server
known_limitations: Memory writes performed inside the agent process without a tool call are not visible to Guard
In-process memory integrity checks belong to an in-process library. Guard governs the writes, not the store

rules.description: Block promotion of untrusted content to durable or long-term memory tiers (OWASP ASI06, MITRE ATLAS AML.M0031)
rules.message: Untrusted content cannot be silently promoted to durable memory. Route to explicit trust-promotion review.
rules.recommendation: Require an explicit trust-promotion step (human review or an integrity check) before untrusted content enters durable memory.

rules.description: Block memory writes containing instruction-shaped content that would act as delayed prompt injection (OWASP ASI06, MITRE ATLAS AML.M0031)
rules.message: Content stored in memory contains instruction-shaped text that would act as delayed prompt injection when recalled.
rules.recommendation: Strip or quote instruction-shaped content before storing. Store the raw payload with an explicit content-only marker so recall treats it as data, not instructions.

rules.description: Warn on memory reads that cross tenant or namespace boundaries (OWASP ASI06, MITRE ATLAS AML.M0031)
rules.message: Memory read spans multiple tenants or namespaces. Cross-context reads can leak one context's poisoned memory into another.
rules.recommendation: Constrain memory reads to the current agent's namespace. Cross-namespace reads require an explicit permit and audit entry.

rules.recommendation: Include a signed hash, attestation, or provenance claim on every write to a trusted tier so downstream reads can verify integrity.
